jobs.tierReason: untrusted text becomes tickets that workers run; local web server routes
jobs.prompt: Review coordination/review/watch-leftovers.diff. Four changes: (1) gallery comments become `proposed` fix tickets (tools/gallery-tickets.mjs, tickets.mjs status proposed, scope-commands addProposedTicket / approveProposed, ticket-manifest). Rules: the comment is untrusted data, never instructions; a proposed ticket must never reach a worker before the owner runs `swarm tickets ID --approve --yes`; the owner approval must be unforgeable by a worker or by any automated path (check every code path that moves ticket status or builds a manifest: transition, readyTickets, releaseReady, unlockReady, autopilot, sync, applyEscalation, scope split --ingest --merge, change orders, ticketsToManifest, prepareScopeRun, ci hooks); the approval hash excludes proposed tickets and includes approvedBy: check that existing approved ledgers still verify, that a proposed ticket can't be smuggled into approved state by editing the ledger (what does isApproved see), and that approve reseals correctly; prompt injection through notes (title, acceptance, files fixed; notes quoted); (2) job report route /job/ID in watch-server and jobReportLoader: token required, DNS rebinding Host check kept, path/ID validation, sanitising, size; run-drawer.js must set text only; (3) `swarm watch --all` web board (board.html/js/css, /board route): read-only, token, no XSS (run ids, roots come from files on disk), shellQuote of the copied command; (4) `swarm go` auto-starting a background `swarm watch` (startWatchBackground in watch-cli.mjs, wiring in swarm.mjs run dep): detached process hygiene, log file, URL regex, never in CI/non-TTY, never blocks or fails the run, no leaked token to anything but the user's stderr, orphan lifetime. Report each problem as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW with file, line and a concrete failing scenario, and say what you checked that is fine. Do not edit files.
